before.reason: Expressive reading builds on basic reading fluency

after.reason: Accurate, increasingly automatic word recognition in the actual grade-level text remains necessary and is assessed by the complete expressive-reading claim. This earlier English fluency repertoire is useful support, but its whole phonically matched-text and downstream exception-word-bank/LTR-print requirements are not universal prerequisites for accurate, appropriately paced, expressive reading with self-correction and rereading in another actual language/script. Keep all those English skills and source-specific requirements; this edge does not permit guessed words, inaccurate rapid reading or memorised recitation to establish mastery.

changes.discriminatingCounterexample: An actual-script reader can meet every grade/stage-appropriate expressive-reading clause without demonstrating the separate English repertoire or LTR behaviour. This is an analytic necessity witness, not an observed child or a claim research participants lack English.

counterexample.status: Original analytic necessity counterexample; no learner observation, efficacy result or claim study participants lack English knowledge.
counterexample.actualScriptWitness: Urdu in its Perso-Arabic right-to-left print form, one possible role realization, not a prescribed national R1/R2 pair.
construction: A pupil reads a genuine grade/stage-appropriate actual-role Urdu passage with all words accurate, meaningful automatic phrasing, appropriate rate, pauses and expressive voice, confirmed by a competent Urdu assessor. This is the stipulated performance, not observed data.

Use a second unseen matched passage to exclude word-for-word memorisation; accurately recognise its real written words. Revisit a first real miscue, if it occurs, by checking actual print/context and independently correcting it. Never induce wrong reading or credit semantic guessing over written words. If no miscue occurs, obtain an independent monitoring/correction opportunity transparently rather than pretend one occurred.
Reread a familiar actual-role passage to demonstrate more fluent, confident phrasing while retaining accuracy; use changed mood/structure at same appropriate grade/stage demand.

Stipulate the pupil has not learned the English exception-word repertoire or English left-to-right print task. The generic actual-role expressive-reading evidence can still be fully met; no inference of that separate repertoire follows from it.
counterexample.decisiveLogic: The general need for accurate automatic recognition within the text does not logically entail the whole fixed English prerequisite claim, its irregular-bank evidence and LTR book behaviour. Script-specific word recognition remains necessary; the overstrong whole-topic hard edge is the proposed correction.
limits: Urdu still has orthographic/phonological conventions and useful high-frequency recognition. It is not claimed to have no decoding, word learning or spelling irregularities.
NCPUL elementary script exercise is used only to verify print direction, not as a primary-grade expressive-reading passage or evidence of a child mastering prosody.
A source-appropriate qualified assessor must select and bind actual texts and accepted readings. No verified actual Urdu pronunciation/assessment pack is fabricated here.
Actual text accuracy and all target clauses stay unchanged; no universal word-per-minute,20-word mastery or new easier stage is substituted.

originalUntestedTask.status: Proposed untested conditional task family; actual language expert/material selection still required, no observations manufactured.
binding: Declare actual role/language/variety/script, exact appropriate-grade/stage source passages, expected readings and locally justified accuracy/prosody scoring before delivery. Do not use NCPUL beginner word-list as a primary passage.

A competent actual-language assessor verifies text rendering, pronunciation, vocabulary, punctuation and accepted expressive readings; no English pronunciation, punctuation, universal rising-question contour or dialect norm is imposed.
Retain complete source stage windows and candidate current age6–12; new grade/difficulty nodes or earlier readiness claims are not proposed.

tasks.operation: Independently read a real grade/stage-appropriate passage, recognising its actual words accurately and sufficiently automatically for connected phrasing. Assess actual pacing and prosody, not mere speed or memorised oral delivery.
tasks.nearMiss: Expressive invented words, rapid guessing, an adult-supplied reading or memorised recitation with no print recognition does not satisfy accuracy.

tasks.operation: Retain an actual spontaneous miscue and evidence that the reader independently checks actual print and context, corrects it and restores meaning. If no opportunity occurs, use a second matched actual text and retain this clause as not yet observed; never induce an error or invent correction evidence.
tasks.nearMiss: Adult points to the right word/says the answer, reader substitutes a plausible word inconsistent with the print, or missing observation is labelled Full.

tasks.operation: After an initial actual read, reread a familiar passage/book section with accurate connected phrasing and increased fluency/confidence; record supports and an attributable change rather than compulsory emotion display.
tasks.nearMiss: Adult rehearses every line or fills the difficult words; a positive mood alone is not reading confidence/fluency.

tasks.operation: Use a fresh matched actual-language passage with different phrasing/mood and a separate meaning question. Keep actual grade/stage demand; distinguish independent word recognition and prosodic interpretation from rehearsing the previous passage.
tasks.nearMiss: Lower the text to an easier level solely to clear source coverage, or apply a Spanish/English pitch template universally.

originalUntestedTask.successRule: All existing target clauses must be met with qualified actual-language evidence. Source-task success, canonical whole-topic mastery and cross-language transfer remain separate; missing actual material, accurate recognition or self-correction evidence cannot be repaired by a softened graph edge.
